purpose: Reference anchors for the EXP-022 three-way comparison. Per-H values are recomputed at full precision from the FROZEN npz of each anchor experiment at evaluate time; only the 4H-mean blocks below are hard gates (atol 1e-5), cross-checked against each anchor's frozen summary.

exp020_aurora_chrono.note: recomputed read-only from EXP-020 frozen npz; gate atol 1e-5

exp021_visionts_raw_order.note: recomputed read-only from EXP-021 frozen Economy npz; gate atol 1e-5

exp022_ours.note: VisionTS with P selected on the ASCENDING validation split; metric = official float32 replica primary, float64 appendix

main_question: Under the SAME ascending test windows and standardization, which has lower error: VisionTS (EXP-022) or the measured Aurora (EXP-020)?

attribution_boundaries.vs_exp020: spans model AND input modality (univariate numeric vs text+numeric); cannot be attributed to the text modality alone
attribution_boundaries.vs_exp021: different test period, history window, standardization statistics and selection basis; describes the two protocols, not row order alone
